scientific_integrity: Analytic all-size inequality proof with explicit bipartite edge-coloring witnesses; supporting integer and rational implementation tests on K3,3 and the cube, not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple cubic bipartite base graphs, uniform positive coupling, three labeled spin colors and strictly ordered external fields. No claim about finite-temperature transitions, uncounted degeneracies, or nonbipartite bases. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Universal five-chamber two-field Potts ground energy on bipartite cubic triangle expansions
